h1: The 7 Best Small Safe Lock Boxes of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best Small Safe Lock Boxes 2026: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: 7 small safe lock boxes for cash, documents and keepsakes, compared on size, locking bolts, mounting and backup access.
summary: The Bonsaii 0.6 cu ft box is our top pick, with two 18mm bolts and three ways to open it. Yuanshikj is the best budget buy. The Master Lock 5900D is the pick if you need a tethered travel box, and KYODOLED suits flat items.
intro: A small lock box is mostly about what it keeps out, and the easy mistake is treating a portable box as if it were bolted down. A box a thief can carry away only protects what is inside until they reach the car.
We reviewed seven small lock boxes from their listings and ranked them on size, bolt count, mounting provision and backup access. Prices run from under $25 to $100, so the ranking leans on features.

products.name: Bonsaii Safe Box with Electronic Keypad for Home Office, 0.6 Cu.Ft
products.verdict: Two 18mm bolts, a shelf and USB-C backup power.
products.description:
The Bonsaii 0.6 cu ft safe lists two 18mm steel locking bolts, a removable shelf, and a mountable design, in the $50-100 tier.

It leads because it is the largest box here and offers three ways in: code, key or USB-C emergency power. That beats the smaller Bonsaii below it.

Choose it for a home office with documents and small valuables. The caveat is a higher price than the compact boxes.
products.skipIf: You only need a tiny box.

products.name: Yuanshikj Small Steel Security Safe Box with Keypad, Key, 0.23 CuFt, Black
products.verdict: Dual bolts and mounting hardware in the lowest tier.
products.description:
Yuanshikj lists 0.2 cu ft of steel construction, dual locking bolts, a magnetic auto-lock door, and pre-drilled holes with bolts included, in the under $25 tier.

It ranks second because it gives up the size and backup power of the Bonsaii, but costs far less.

It suits cash and passports. The caveat is the small interior.
products.idealFor: Budget buyers who want to mount it.
products.skipIf: You need to store large items.

products.name: Bonsaii Small Safe Box with Electronic Keypad for Valuables, 0.23 Cu.Ft
products.verdict: USB-C emergency power in a small mountable box.
products.description:
This Bonsaii lists 0.23 cu ft, pre-drilled installation holes and USB-C emergency power, in the $25-50 tier.

It ranks third because it adds backup power over Yuanshikj, but costs more for a similar size.

It suits closets and nightstands. The caveat is that the interior is small.

products.name: Digital Electronic Money Safe, Steel Security Lock Box with Keypad, Office
products.verdict: Two independent access codes in SPCC steel.
products.description:
This safe lists a 4.6 L SPCC steel body, a mountable design, two independent access codes and a carpet liner, in the $25-50 tier.

It ranks fourth because dual codes help shared offices but it lacks the bolt detail of the leaders.

It suits shared spaces. The caveat is that bolt count is not listed.

products.name: PATRON Small Safe Box for Money with Code and Keys
products.verdict: Two anti-pry bolts and a corrosion-resistant finish.
products.description:
PATRON lists 0.236 cu ft, a mountable design, two anti-pry steel bolts and a corrosion-resistant coating, in the $25-50 tier.

It ranks fifth because it matches the Bonsaii 0.23 on size but offers no backup power. It also warns against storing keys inside the box.

It suits households with a few valuables. The caveat is limited extras.

products.name: Master Lock Small Travel Safe with Cable, Gray Combination Lock Box, 5900D
products.verdict: A tethered combination box that is not mountable.
products.description:
The Master Lock 5900D lists a tether cable, a 4-digit combination with no key, a charging cable port and water resistance, in the under $25 tier.

It ranks sixth because it cannot be mounted, unlike the others. Its strength is portability.

It suits hotel rooms and travel. The caveat is that it is not for fixed home storage.

products.name: KYODOLED Safe Box with Digital Keypad Lock, Lock Box with Code for Personal Items
products.verdict: A wide flat interior with a spring-loaded lid.
products.description:
KYODOLED lists an 11.7 by 9.12 by 2.75 inch interior, a spring-loaded lid, a 3 to 8 digit code and 2 emergency keys, in the $25-50 tier.

It ranks last because the flat shape limits what fits. It suits documents and tablets better than jewelry boxes.

It suits flat items. The caveat is the shallow depth.

whatMatters.detail: A box you can bolt down is much harder to carry away. Look for pre-drilled holes and included bolts. If the listing says portable only, treat it as a convenience box, not a security measure.
Bolts are the steel pins that hold the door shut. Thicker bolts, such as 18mm, resist prying better. Look for the bolt count and diameter in the bullets.
Electronic locks run on batteries that can die. USB-C emergency power or an override key avoids a lockout. Check which backups the listing offers.
Cubic feet is the key size number. A 0.23 cu ft box holds cash and passports, while a 0.6 cu ft box takes documents. Check the interior dimensions, not just the outside.
Keypads are quick but need batteries, key locks never fail electronically but keys can be lost, and combination locks need no battery. Choose by how you will use it.

faq.a: If you need document space, yes. Otherwise the smaller box is fine.
Pick a stud, shelf or cabinet floor, mark the holes and fasten with the included bolts.

faq.q: How do I maintain a keypad safe?
faq.a: Replace batteries on schedule, and keep the emergency key outside the box.

faq.q: Can I travel with a mounted box?
faq.a: Not easily. The Master Lock 5900D is better for travel.

finalTake: The Bonsaii 0.6 cu ft is our top small lock box for its size, bolts and backup power. Yuanshikj is the best budget pick, and Master Lock is the travel pick. Mount whichever you choose.
